entities.name: Naîgnouma Coulibaly
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Naîgnouma Coulibaly is a Malian women's basketball player with Cavigal Nice Basket of the Ligue Féminine de Basketball and the Mali women's national basketball team. After winning the FIBA Africa Championship for Women 2007, Coulibaly represented Mali at the 2008 Summer Olympics.
